label: Tavneos-demand-counterpart
body:
Avacopan for treating severe active granulomatosis with polyangiitis or microscopic polyangiitis
Technology appraisal guidance
Reference number: TA825
Published: 21 September 2022
NICE has withdrawn this guidance. CSL Vifor will stop marketing avacopan (Tavneos) because its marketing authorisation has been suspended by the Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA). CSL Vifor has issued a direct letter to healthcare professionals specialising in treating the conditions for which avacopan was indicated. No new people will start taking avacopan in the UK. Healthcare professionals should discuss alternative treatment options with people currently having avacopan.
